AUTOMATIC TRANSAXLE

STEP 4. Check the continuity at combination meter 
connector C-43.
(1) Disconnect connector C-43 and measure at the harness 
side.
(2) Check for the continuity between terminal 12 and ground.
• Should be less than 2 ohm.
Q: Is the continuity normal?
YES : Go to Step 6.
NO : Go to Step 5.
STEP 5. Check connector C-43 at combination meter for 
damage.
Q: Is the connector in good condition?
YES : Repair it because of harness open circuit or harness 
damage between combination meter connector C-43 
terminal 12 and the ground.
NO : Repair or replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness 
Connector Inspection P.00E-2.
